title: RatKing Spite Rack Is A Lightweight (269g) Front Rack With A Integrated Light Mount
content:
With no tombstone, the RatKing Spite can be used with a Cradle or similar to double up on dry bags. Use it as a bag support or throw your skateboard on it. Zip-tie a basket to it, ya deviant. A removable, adjustable, ambidextrous light mount is included.

As always, good straps and basic technique will keep your cargo from falling through the open platform. Don’t go OTB…

Ratking Spite Rack Quick Hits

  • 4.5 × 8″ platform
  • Weighs 269 g with uncut 355 mm struts + light mount
  • 6 kg load limit
  • Removable, adjustable, ambidextrous light mount included
  • 2.4″ Max Tire Size – 2.85″ between struts at their narrowest.
  • Requires
    • Mid-fork eyelets
    • M5 or M6 fork-crown mounting hole/thread
    • The rack is supplied with an M6 passthrough bolt (55 mm long). M5 mounting hardware is not included.
    • *Struts will need to be spread and/or shaped to mount to your specific fork.*
  • Strut mounting hardware is silver across the board. Struts are color matched to the platform: black with Black, silver with Rainbow Chrome.

Get yours today over at RatKing Frames.
